verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's first-party docs say every action in the admin application is tracked and logged, so the values that flags, identities and segments have taken over time can be retraced. Audit logs can also be streamed to your own infrastructure via Audit Log Webhooks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that each entry captures the actor (who) and a timestamp (when), coverage of changes made through the Admin API, CLI or MCP rather than only the dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
